question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"except."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Except"** means excluding or not including. (को छोड़कर; इसके सिवा)

 
 
• **Example**: *Everyone is invited to the party, **except**__ for John.*
 
 
 
• It is used to indicate that something/someone is not part of a group or category.
 
• It is often followed by the word **"for"** or **"from."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

Amla tree is __considered__ to be thousands of years old. It is called aamaleki and dhaatri in Sanskrit. Its botanical name is Emblica Officinalis. The amla tree is a medium __sized__ tree with citrus fruits. It is found almost everywhere in India __**except**__ for some very high mountainous regions. It is found ______ (4) ______ in Madhya Pradesh. The leaves are very small and have a close ______ (5) ______ to those of Gulmohar. The amla tree has slender branches which grow upwards and surround the trees on all sides.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Till"** means up to a certain time or point. (एक निश्चित समय या बिंदु तक)
 
• **"Without"** means not having or doing something, or being free from something. ((किसी वस्‍तु) के बिना, के बग़ैर)
 
• **"Unless" **means except if; used to indicate that a particular situation must exist before something else can happen. (यदि... नहीं; तब तक नहीं जब तक)

44:Td20,

The correct answer is **"abundantly."**
